q: 为什么不按单词首字母分桶？
Why not pick the bucket by the word's first letter?
a: 太不均匀：八本书里 s 开头的不同单词有 2,691 个，z 开头的只有 12 个。有的 reducer 忙死，有的闲着。
Far too uneven: across the eight books 2,691 distinct words start with s and only 12 with z. Some reducers drown while others sit idle.
why: 统计自 data/runs.sh 里 mrsequential 的真实输出（按首字母小写计数）。
Counted from mrsequential's real output in data/runs.sh (first letter, lower-cased).

q: "of" 八本书里都有。有几个中间文件装着它？
"of" is in all eight books. How many intermediate files hold it?
a: 8 个：mr-0-6 到 mr-7-6。ihash 只看词本身，所以每一行都把 "of" 放进第 6 列。
Eight: mr-0-6 through mr-7-6. ihash looks only at the word, so every row puts "of" in column 6.
why: In the real run the eight map tasks hold 485, 2,251, 2,746, 1,461, 1,753, 541, 2,734 and 1,565 "of" pairs, all in bucket 6.

q: 每个桶的不同单词数在 2,173 到 2,251 之间，很均匀。那为什么每个桶的词对数从 39,508 到 105,743 不等？
Distinct words per bucket are even (2,173 to 2,251). Why do pairs per bucket range from 39,508 to 105,743?
a: 哈希平衡的是键，不是工作量。少数几个词特别多：6 号桶有 "of"（13,536 个），2 号桶有 "the"（29,748 个）。一个常见的键总落在同一个 reducer 上。
A hash balances keys, not work. A few words are huge: bucket 6 holds "of" (13,536) and bucket 2 holds "the" (29,748). One common key always lands on one reducer.
why: 真实运行，nReduce = 10，统计每个 reduce 任务读入的词对数和输出的行数。
Real run with nReduce = 10, counting the pairs each reduce task reads and the lines it writes.

q: map 任务 7 还在跑时，6 号 reduce 能开始吗？
Can reduce task 6 start while map task 7 is still running?
a: 不能。第 6 列还缺 mr-7-6，"of" 会少 1,565 个，输出 of 11971 而不是 of 13536。所有 map 完成后 reduce 才能开始。
No. Column 6 is still missing mr-7-6, so "of" would be 1,565 short and the output would say of 11971 instead of of 13536. Reduce starts only after every map task is done.
why: The count of "of" in mr-7-6 (Tom Sawyer) is from the real run; 13,536 − 1,565 = 11,971.

q: Hash "the" by hand: which bucket does it go to?
a: 2 号桶。FNV-1a 得到 3,020,861,980，最高位是 1；掩码 & 0x7fffffff 清掉它得 873,378,332；对 10 取余得 2。
Bucket 2. FNV-1a gives 3,020,861,980, whose top bit is set; the mask & 0x7fffffff clears it, giving 873,378,332; mod 10 gives 2.
why: data.py 逐字节算出同样的值，并和真实运行里 "the" 所在的桶（2）核对；mr-out-2 里有 "the 29748"。
data.py computes the same values byte by byte and checks them against the bucket "the" landed in during the real run (2); mr-out-2 contains "the 29748".

q: 如果忘了掩码 & 0x7fffffff，在 64 位的 Go 上 ihash("the") % 10 会变吗？
If you dropped the mask & 0x7fffffff, would ihash("the") % 10 change on 64-bit Go?
a: 会。h.Sum32() 是 3,020,861,980，转成 64 位 int 仍是正数，3,020,861,980 % 10 = 0，不是 2。"the" 会进 0 号桶。只要所有 worker 都用同一个函数，结果仍然正确，只是桶号不同。

Yes. h.Sum32() is 3,020,861,980, still positive as a 64-bit int, and 3,020,861,980 % 10 = 0, not 2. "the" would go to bucket 0. As long as every worker uses the same function the output is still correct; only the bucket numbers change.
why: 按 worker.go 第 21 行和 FNV-1a 的结果推算；没有修改 worker.go 去实测。
Worked out from worker.go line 21 and the FNV-1a value; not measured by changing worker.go.

q: 测试 TestWc 只比较合并排序后的输出。如果你把 nReduce 换成别的数，测试还会过吗？
TestWc compares only the merged, sorted output. Would it still pass if a different nReduce were used?
a: 会。只要每个词只进一个桶，合并排序后的内容就和 mrsequential 的一样，跟桶的个数无关。（但 mrcoordinator.go 固定传 10，而且不让改。）

Yes. As long as each word goes to exactly one bucket, the merged sorted output equals mrsequential's whatever the number of buckets. (mrcoordinator.go always passes 10, though, and must not be changed.)
why: mr_test.go 第 18–22 行：mkCorrectOutput、mergeOutput 排序后用 cmp 逐字节比较，不看文件个数。
mr_test.go lines 18–22: mkCorrectOutput and mergeOutput sort, then cmp compares byte for byte; the number of files isn't checked here.
